t:
You cannot simply buy things frrom Quartermasters, eysh! First you need to earn enough rreputation.

Earning reputation is easy - just complete our quests, find things that we need. The more you help us, the higher is your rreputation in our eyes. Once you've earned our frriendship, we will offer you our uncommon equipment. Once you've earned our trrust, you will be able to buy rare items from us, eysh!
Take a look at my goods!
Take a look at my goods!
Take a look at my goods!

r511296.s: Priestess of the Church of Light

t: What? No, I'm not afraid to die...
h: No real Orc is afraid of dying in battle!

t: I worry about them more than myself! It's not that...
h: Think about the others! Are you really going to let them die?!

t: The Orc shuffles his feet, uncertain.
What? No, I'm not afraid to die...
h: Think how much respect it will earn you when they hear about the monster you fought!

t:
Don't you think you're a little too skinny, fella? Couldn't they send someone a bit tougher? I'm gonna knock you cold in no time, huh!

Come on, show me what you got.

To defeat me, you need to land at least ten blows. Here, bet a silver coin on your victory. You might get lucky!
Hah! You have no coins, then? Bring me a silver coin, then we'll talk.

You have my respect! I thought you're just another weakling, but I can see I was wrong!

Wait, don't go back to the ring right now. Take a break - you need it!

Look at you! You're all blue with bruises.

Come again later, I'll show you some more moves, huh!

Alright, I believe you. You fight bravely, wingless. I am glad you are on our side.

The minotaur's bandits are hunting Aviaks down because we are refusing to obey their stupid rules! We fly wherever we want, and no one limits our freedom! If they have a problem with that, this means we are at war. And if you want to help, this is good news!
h: Assure the Aviak that you are on the same side

quests: The Bane of the Kingdom: The Shamans

t: Can't you see I'm busy. What is it that you want?
Alice and I met at the Old Town a while ago.
h: You're Lena, right? Do you know Alice well? For how long?

t:
Why are you ask... Ooh!

I'm... I'm just a pioneer. I mostly read and stroll. Nothing special. We've been stuck here for a long while, so the books are read from cover to cover. Especially since Eugenie closed the library. Fortunately, other pioneers can exchange the books.

I'm reading a great book about the fall of the House de Vevre. It's called "Captured by the Astral Storm."

My name is Lena. I don't know what to tell you.

Together with my sister we arrived at this camp from the Kanian allod Zlatovest. That was after Yasker and Antoinette signed the exchange agreement for the League to visit this place and the Empire to visit us.

It's a curious place. But sometimes it seems that I've been here for too long.

I studied... well, I wore the uniform of a noble institute... but what did I study? I don't remember... I got married... Took a nasty wife... And for what? I don't understand... I spent everything I had – I wore some kind of gray jacket and red trousers... but how did I go broke? I didn't notice... I served in the state chamber... a uniform, a cap with a cockade... I squandered state money – they put a prisoner's uniform on me... then I put this on... And everything... was like a dream... huh? Is that... funny?

Greetings! I'm Leticia de Desirae, a monster huntress!

You must know my cousin, Prince Dakkar who is quite famous... I want to be famous, too, so I started hunting all kinds of dangerous creatures.

As you know, once they put things in order on Umoir, all sorts of vermin decided to settle at the edge of the allod, meaning right here. New enemies joined the old ones. That's what you and I will be dealing with. We'll do it this way: I mark the enemy on the map, you go and kill it, then I pay you, and we divide the loot 50/50! Yes, I knew you'd agree.

quests: Al Rihat Ruins: Helping the Monster Huntress
Al Rihat Monster Hunting: Tord the Fierce

t:
This is the Trial of Blood. Here, you cannot make mistakes. If you die, you start all over again. If you survive, you earn my respect. If you win fast, you are greatly rewarded.

Shall we start the Trial?

Shall we start the Trial?

This is the Trial of Blood. Here, you cannot make mistakes. If you die, you start all over again. If you survive, you earn my respect. If you win fast, you are greatly rewarded.

Shall we start the Trial?
Why are we so afraid of the truth? Negus Menes was always saying that truth would set us free.

quests: Pledge of Punishment: Goblins of the Northern Sand Bar

t:
This resort offers various ways to have fun - races on snow boards and sledges, snowball battles and figure skating. Those who prefer less extreme entertainment can enjoy fishing on the frozen lake, drink some hot mulled wine, and launch colorful fireworks into the sky!

Come to the Snow Resort and have the best vacation ever!

Olé, olé, olé! Sarnaut is the best!

I wish we could play real football! Just imagine, you run up to the gates, kick the ball, the stadium roars... You scored a goal! Oh, it's such a pity Sarnaut doesn't have its own football team. I bet we would've won all cups!

Do you want to take a look at football uniforms? See, they're from different countries! It's very good for goblinball, too. Try it!

The time of Arg comes when the sun is so scorching that you hardly step outside! It is a time when nothing compares to the beauty of the smooth surface of the deep lakes, glittering like silver in the sunlight! The magical moon shines brightly, like a silver coin against the night sky. On this day, those born under the sign of Arg will be blessed by their Patron!

The time of Patron Ferr comes in late autumn, on the brink of winter, when the first lattice of ice appears on the puddles and icy winds nip at our summer-soft cheeks. And his patronage is granted only to those of a stout, hardened body and an unbending will... Those who are as durable as iron!

When the raging cold starts giving in to the reviving nature, it marks the time of Patron Xos. As bright sunrays reflect off the melting icicles, the flames of life begins to stir and awaken in the hearts of those favored by Xos' patronage. For Xos will only bestow his blessings upon those who are as ardent as phosphorus!

The gloomiest time of the year belongs to Patron Irsen. They say that the caustic and irritable old man Irsen would accept no weather but heavy clouds overhead, a piercing chill and lifeless trees. The old Great Martyr laughs at those who run for shelter at the first sounds of falling rain. And his patronage is granted only to the clever, quick to reply to weaklings' whining about the foul weather with a wry joke. This is the time of those born under the sign of Irsen, those who are as caustic as arsenic!

These grim days are the time of Patron Caprey. The dull sun is like a copper coin that gives less and less warmth with each passing day... The children of piercing cold and lashing winds will never break under the blows of fate. They are flexible like copper! They are those lucky ones the great Martyr Caprey offers his favor to.

Once a year Novograd and Nezebgrad celebrate the day of the Bard. The festival fills the cities with crowds of people in bright costumes and colorful masks parading along the streets. They are celebrating all night long, and the sounds of laughter and merry songs echo around the streets and squares till the first rays of dawn.

People say that even the Patrons take a rest from their labors on this day. They come down to the city to watch the parade and enjoy the beautiful music. The celebrations do not end the morning after the parade. People enjoy an extra few days of holiday afterward. Every bard, every minstrel, every troubadour, even a boy with a simple flute can obtain holiday gifts from me!

No one has learned the secrets of Nature as deeply as Wardens. They command the powers of wind and water, earth and fire. They speak the languages of thousands of creatures, and animals eat from their hands. The Warden's way is the way of balance. It is tough but honorable. The ones who live in harmony with the Nature will be glorified!
At this time of year, Wardens celebrate their holiday and praise the Nature. I am glad to offer you special wares to commemorate this holiday!

Look around. Can you see all these engineers with their crafty devices? Do you know why they are here? It's their professional holiday, the day of Motorcade. They share their inventions, demonstrate blueprints to one another and develop new curious machines together. Don't miss the fun!

If you are also fascinated by the machinery, why don't you take a look at my souvenirs?

Every Great Mage has a treasure they guard the most - a book to write down the most powerful and dangerous spells. Mages keep such records throughout their entire lives, which tend to last quite a long time. Every year the book gets thicker. Spellcasters decorate their books with steel fasteners, seals and images of horrid demons. Protective spells cast on such a book can animate the demon, which spells a world of trouble for any petty thief!
Ordinarily such books never leave the spellcaster's treasury. And there are only a few days in the year when magicians bring out their battered heavy volumes, wipe the dust from the covers, and get down to work recalling old spells, recording new ones, and meeting other magicians to exchange their knowledge. Mages call this day Librarium and consider it a professional holiday. During Librarium I can offer mages unique magic souvenirs!

According to legends, once a year, the deadmen rise from their graves to start their terrifying Dance of Death. Woe to the traveler who got pulled into their ring! That unfortunate wretch would dance until he falls dead, just to rise from the grave the next spring and dance again from dusk till dawn, clattering his bones and scaring the mortals.
This legend is known for hundreds of years, but I have yet to meet someone who saw the dancing undead with their own eyes. Summoners call the Dance of Death their holiday, and I offer them special wares during the celebration.

The Intercession is a special day. On this day we praise the Light for everything it has blessed us with: the eternal life and the Holy magic. The Church of Light and the Trinity Church are disputing who we should thank in particular: whether it's Tensess, Nezeb or Skrakan. Let us forget the arguments for a while and laud the Light and its gifts! As far as the Healers are concerned, we have got the sacred garments and relics for them!

Have you looked at the stars on a warm summer night? How beautiful they are! A glittering threads of diamonds on black velvet... Exquisite lace of constellations... I can't find the words to describe my excitement!
But the most beautiful time is Star Shower! For a few summer nights the sky is crossed with shooting stars. Young and old alike are making wishes which will come true for sure. These nights Psionicists draw up the most accurate horoscopes and make the clearest predictions!
I'm offering special goods to every Psionicist who visits me during the Star Shower celebration!

At the dawn of its existence, the Church did not intervene in human affairs. Both the priests of the Church of Light and the clergy of the Trinity Church would preach, bless, heal, perform burial rites and spread faith in the Power of Light. No-no, the Church never forced anyone to accept faith in the Light - true faith can only be accepted with an open heart, not by coercion! Still, there were those who stood in the Church's way.
Heretics, renegades and other kinds of vicious savages not only denied faith in Light, they also attacked priests, plundered churches, destroyed chapels... It was then that the clerics summoned the Wrath of retribution upon the heads of the wicked! There were some priests who took off their robes, vowing to protect their faith through force, and took the fight to the enemies of the Light! Those valiant souls became the first Paladins, loyal servants and fearless defenders of the Church, wielding the power granted by the Light.
h: Ask about the Day of Wrath

t: No, you don't have to be afraid! The Demonologists are our allies like the Healers and Paladins. They just follow their own, special path! And today is their Pandemonium holiday. Today, all followers of this dark path are celebrating a great event - about a hundred years ago, a group of mages decided to unlock the secrets of astral creatures, wanting to protect the other inhabitants of Sarnaut from their deadly onslaught. And today, all Demonologists are eager to demonstrate their skills.
Starting on day 6 of the holiday, you can repeat daily quests for 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin.

Everybody has their own destiny... Some are destined to make scientific discoveries, others - to create artistic masterpieces, bake bread or raise children. But there are also those whose life consists of short breaks between bloody battles. Those whose lot it is to fight constantly from birth to death. These are called warriors, and there is nobody in the world who could compete with them in honest one-on-one combat!
The art of war does not tolerate laziness or weakness. A true warrior is always ready to repel the enemy, and only during the Swordring can a warrior throw off their armor, put down their sword and drink ale in the company of like-minded veterans, chatting about past deeds and testing their strength and combat skill against other warriors, for their own enjoyment and that of the audience. And warriors that call in to the Holiday Commitee Officials during the Swordring can acquire special festive goods.

Look alive, my hearties! Today marks the anniversary of the birth of a person without whom there would be no League! It is he that we Kanians, Elves, and Gibberlings should thank for the peaceful, prosperous existence we enjoy now. His wisdom, dedication, and compassion have made the League into a great power, capable of squelching any aggression. If not for his astute sense and sharp wit, who knows what havoc the demons' invasion would have wrought on Sarnaut?
So it is with all our heart that we congratulate our Great Mage Aidenus, and we wish him... well, each of us can tell him our wishes individually. As for me, I wish him the strength to maintain his dedication, his purposeful and passionate quest to help the people!
Come see me for birthday souvenirs and gifts, if you're so inclined.

h: Ask about the Day of Fun

t: Hyrd's time is the hot and sunlit days, when you can sunbathe on the beach, enjoy swimming and take part in competitions of quickness and dexterity! This is the time of those who are as swift as mercury!

Those born under the sign of Lex are as sharp as silicon!
Lex's time is the blooming hour of nature. Crops appears in the fields, and even the bookworms divert their attention from dusty volumes to the beauty of the outdoors!

Those who were born under the sign of Rokoit are as strong as chromium!
Rokoit celebration takes place at the turning point, when nature shakes off the snow, emerging from its dormancy, and starts blossoming in the gentle sunrays. On these days, those born under the sign of Rokoit will be blessed by their Patron!

Those who were born under the sign of Ulf are as passionate as sulfur!
The revival of nature marks Ulf's time, when trees are blossoming, the sun is shining, and hearts beat faster! Ulf is gracious to those who are hot-tempered and passionate.

Born from the struggle between chaos and order, the Aoidoi became a true sensation for the other people of Sarnaut. This majestic and wise civilization was granted a source of power comparable to the power of the gods themselves! The origin of the Aoidoi is rather unique: the Aoidoi are children of two gods, creatures created by a cosmic catastrophe that put an end to a long confrontation. Now they celebrate the day when Polis, their first city, was founded. The festival itself was organized by Dominus Dionysius and named in his honor.
Starting on day 6 of the holiday, you can repeat daily quests for 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin.
You are now a participant of the Dionysia! Celebrate this event heartily!
h: Unlock the ability to become an organizer for the Dionysia

t:
Hour of the Awakening... According to legends, this is when the first of the reborn Elves opened his eyes and saw the new world. The snow was melting, springs were prattling, and buds started to swell. Nature was waking up after long winter sleep!
Elves spend the whole week in delight and silent contemplation. Even the Great Game is paused for the time of celebration!
Every elf who visits me during this holiday will be offered special wares at a huge discount!
h: Ask about the Hour of the Awakening

t:
Gibberlings are eager for adventures. They love travels, discovering new lands and creatures.
At this time of year the most famous Gibberling adventurers gather to celebrate their achievements. They boast of the artifacts they found and tell stories of their adventures.
Every Gibberling who visits me during this festival will be able to buy rare goods from distant lands.

Unity Day is the greatest day in Kanian history.
Long ago, before our world was torn to pieces, the great nation of Junes died. New tribes emerged from the ruins of the ancient civilization. They called themselves "Aro", which is translated as "humans". Their tiny dominions soon became engaged into petty squabbles. They were losing their best warriors in endless conflicts, until orcs invaded to their lands. Single tribes could not withstand them...
One day, when earth was red with blood and the sky was covered with smoke from burning villages, leaders of the remaining tribes managed to set their discords aside and swore eternal friendship to each other. United army of Aro defeated the Orcs and kicked them back to wilderness. The Orcs still remember this defeat...
Once a desperate measure, this union grew into a true friendship. Eventually the tribes welded into one strong nation, the great Kania.
Let everyone raise a toast today to the glory of our nation! I offer special festive goods to every Kanian who visits me.

Today is the Great Feast! Ah, I wish I could see Howlem now. You Pridens celebrate as passionately as you fight!

I have traditional Priden costumes in my assortment - so beautiful and warm! - and also some hunter's horns.

Have a nice holiday!

See that rainbow in the sky? One may ask, how come there's a rainbow without rain? The answer is simple: alchemists are celebrating their professional holiday!
Dozens of alchemical labs work day and night, producing potions and brews, and alchemists dust off their tractates and start their quest for the philosopher's stone with renewed vigor! The caustic multicolored smoke raises into the sky, entwining into a beautiful rainbow.
We congratulate all alchemists on Rainbow Holiday!

Hear the ringing everywhere? That's not bells. That's our merry blacksmiths. They hauled their anvils onto the street and are hammering the hell out of them for everyone to know: today is their holiday, Hammerstrike Day!

Since ancient times, blacksmiths were respected and feared, they were almost considered sorcerers. And for good reason: unlike tailors or carpenters, they work in flames and smoke, sparks flying, hammers clashing deafeningly. Skilled hands turn a piece of metal into a strong set of armor or delicate lace. I ask you: if that's not magic, what is?

Today, we honor the blacksmiths. Do you belong to their trade, by the way? If so, I'll be happy to exchange your anniversary coins for holiday souvenirs!

Needle Eye is a professional holiday of tailors.
What a wonderful holiday it is! Tailors demonstrate their best masterpieces to their colleagues and passers-by, they hang beautiful tapestries outside of their shops, boasting about rich patterns and durable weaving. During the holiday you can buy fine boots, luxurious coats and embroidered cloaks at huge discounts - there is a long-time tradition to keep prices low on the Needle Eye Day.
Tailors who visit me during the holiday will be able to buy special items.

A long-long time ago, at the dawn of times, our ancestors' own skin was their only clothes. After a while it occurred to them that whipping a hide from someone furry would be a nice idea. This is how the craft of tanning was born. Today is tanners' professional holiday. Our greetings and souvenirs to all those who scrape, tan, lime, scour, mill, shape, dye and sew!

This is a special day. Though it is dedicated to all those who craft deadly weapons, today we celebrate peace, which our sharp swords and martial prowess enable us to preserve. Weaponcrafters of the capital have a day off their honorable duty and demonstrate their astonishing blades and shining armor! Teenagers wrestle jokingly in the streets - and to tell you the truth, so do the grown-ups! If you are a weapon maker, you can buy memorable souvenirs from me during the event.

Many ages ago, before the League and the Empire existed and the world was still whole, experienced hunters and their apprentices would head deep into the woods for one week to face challenging trials. Sneak up to an elk, catch a cautious hare with a sophisticated snare, find a hiding place on a plain... The hunters staged plenty of tests for their apprentices! After this week of trials, which they dubbed the Silent Days, the apprentice became a full-fledged hunter.
The world has changed, but the tradition remains. To this day the Scouts test their rookies, checking their dexterity, observation, archery and stealth. It has been tradition on the Silent Days to congratulate those who have become Scouts and remember those who once were one...

If you want to say something important to everyone, the Megaphone is perfect for that. But don't overdo it. Each subsequent purchased Megaphones will cost a little more. However, at the beginning of the next game week, the price of the Megaphone will return to its normal level Let me know if you want to buy a Megaphone. If you have enough money, I will sell it to you.

Biting frost, blizzard and chilling colds - that's what awaits those born under the sign of Plam. Those who survive the hardships of this time of the year are transformed into stern, tough and reliable protectors of Sarnaut and develop a heavy temper. As heavy as lead!

At the turn of the year, when the earth is covered with a thick blanket of snow, comes the time of Patron Stagan. A sole mistress over the land, the winter shows no mercy to the weak and stupid. Of those born in winter, only the most durable survive to see spring. Those lucky souls are favored by Patron Stagan's blessing, for they are as durable as tin!

The golden halo of the sun hovers in the midday sky... Golden rye sprouts up in the fields... Gold and laces distinguish those favored by Patron Uar's blessing! The hottest days in the midsummer are the time of Uar, the time of those as spiteful as gold!
I can tell you about the League holidays. If you visit me during a celebration that applies to you, I will sell you special holiday items.
I can trade your medals for useful rewards.
Sorry, I can't help you with that. Ask other Holiday Committee Officials.
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a gallant chevalier.

t: Sorry, I can't help you with that. Ask other Holiday Committee Officials.
h: Ask for a piece of advice for a beautiful lady.

t: My uncle decided to marry me off. He paid my debt. I could not refuse, I had to show myself to her... It was the most dreadful day! The bride turned out to be a pretentious young lady, one of those who spend all day chirping tirelessly about silks, romance, and poems.

Greetings, wanderer!

I remember that you had a chance to visit the wonderful Lumix Isle where ignorance fights enlightenment, and paganism fights faith in the Sacred Flame! We are here by the will of the Avatar of Light - the new, true goddess of Light, one of the many goddesses and gods of Light. We know it was you who managed to send a signal to Enod and call them to our world... Let us praise the Light!
Only guild members with the Officer title or higher can do this!

Look at it. Isn't it marvelous? But any creature needs a resource to continue its existence... or a semblance of one.

Sparks are a great material for sustaining life both in living creatures and machines. I have a couple of tasks for you. If you handle them, we can make our Keeper stronger.
I'm just a secretary, so I beg you... Where did these rats come from?
A smile and a few words, and whoever is in love is ready for anything.

The silly baby mouse is crying for answers. You asked your questions. You have your answers. It's your fault if you don't know how to treat them.

Go now. Your foolishness is tiresome.
h: Demand to show you the way to Darkness.

t: Remember how we met, buddy? Who could have thought you'd be the one to find Isa?Remember how we met, buddy? Who could have thought you'd be the one to find Isa?Remember how we met, buddy? Who could have thought you'd be the one to find Isa?I never imagined Isa would be found…I never imagined Isa would be found…I never imagined Isa would be found…I never imagined Isa would be found…I never imagined Isa would be found… But it happened! It's hard to say what this will mean for the Gibberlings! Most likely, more than we can imagine and not as much as the other nations think. The meaning of Isa is more symbolic than anything else. In the end, we also have New Isa, Ingos, Gravestein, many colony islands. Besides, everyone has learned how to build their own allods, so there is enough land. What matters is we have achieved our goal and now we will need another one. What it's going to be depends on us Gibberlings. And on you, too.
You again? Want me to take you back?
Oh, I'm so old and powerless, anyone can take advantage over me... All right, come on board.

r483386.s: Priestesse of the Church of Light

r507738.s: Head of the House de Desirae

t: Greetings from the House de Desirae!

Catherina knows how to impress people, . I have no doubt her creation is worth a lot, though everyone present will try to diminish its importance.

But if we let go of our habit of negating other people's projects, this ship is an outstanding creation of the human race...

Our approaches are quite different. When you visited the Galleon Castle, you had the opportunity to see that. But the Eclipse serves its purpose well. I'm curious what this project on Suslanger will amount to. After all, it's trying to combine different traditions.

Congratulations, .

It's nice to meet you again, !

Oh, this year has been delightful. Thirty years have passed since the Ball where we won, and every day of those years has been a real torment, I swear. Ruling your own House is not easy, and running the Elven Houses, this ball of snakes... You can imagine how hard it can be...

Nevertheless, I continue to closely monitor what is happening in our world. While my son is on an extremely important mission, things are taking their course. As I expected, the appearance of the Great Mage among the Orcs caused unrest in the Empire. Realizing this, Yasker tried to mitigate the possible consequences by forming an alliance with the League, thereby gaining a respite and time for re-equipping his forces.

For the first time since the foundation of the League, we have a situation where the balance of power can radically change.
Oh, Ivan, where are you, my soul?! I lost you. How can I find a loved one in a changed world where restless souls wander?

h: Do you have something for me?

quests: Meeting with the Keeper of Secrets

t:
It’s not surprising that people would believe in it! We even offered the Templars to place the idol of Light in our shrine, and let people choose whom to bring offerings to. But they wouldn’t. They decided to attack us, instead.

As to your question, it is no secret. The idol depicts Peregrina, a young maiden of great might, who saved us from the Leper. She pointed to a safe place and protected us with her power. Our people trust in her now and forever, that is why we erected the idol. You may talk to Peregrina, she’s young and restless, always travel around the world, and if you choose to speak to her, it takes as much as a sacrifice of a handful of dust, and she’ll promptly reply!

Someone has to let the world know about what happened. You have the Adventurer's Stone, don't you? So go to your Yasker, sound the alarm, tell him to set his troops on full combat alert! And give my stone to the seeress. If she can really sense the Architects, we need to save her at any cost!

Take my stone, and off you go!
I will try and hold them back as long as I can. I will die before I let them pass!
Umpf... There went our last chance.
Are you alright? Can you walk?

Ah, my pleasure. We are lucky to have stayed alive. I've never seen time freeze before!

I heard the sounds of battle somewhere near - it looks like some of the Hunters are still alive. We need to break through to them! I don't know who those Architects are, but they are going to regret coming here in the first place!
Close your eyes... One, two, three!

The silly cow moos, the jackdaw is screeching, the turbulent peasants still shout, and the echo maliciously mocks them. It has only one concern - to tease honest people, to frighten children and women!

quests: The Plague of the Wandering Island

t: Alice? Of course, I do. Alice is a good friend and a worthy comrade.

Hiding. Observing. It's fun.

There are many events happening, you only need to observe them quietly. For example, there's a hatch under the medical unit. It leads to a secret lab. Viola often goes there. She's experimenting.

I'm Maas Yulee, a Priden from Nezebgrad. I live in the south-eastern district. I overheard that Suslanger gathers all pioneers, so I wanted to travel to this hot place. Joined the group, and then joined their ranks as well.
Rare punch card for y'all lovers of classic! Only for the true aficionados!

Papyrus? Who would need that kind of old junk? I had piles of 'em, but I ended up tossing them out because rats started feeding on 'em. You look around if you need 'em. I've stacked them around the corners somewhere so that I didn't have to carry them to the recycler...
Does the mortal want to ask a question?
Hear me... Come to the Maiden's call...

The time has come!

Follow me. You will see it with your eyes.
Woe to me and woe to you! This is the dark time for my dear Umoir! No good faith, no bad faith, there’s only true faith!

There is hope, but very little hope. The Leper eats down Umoir day after day, hour after hour, and the Queen takes no notice. Why doesn’t she care? I don’t understand that. May be you can talk a little sense into her?

quests: Knowledge is Power: The First Lesson
Knowledge is Power: The Final Lesson

t: Thank Tensess! We are so grateful!
h: Tell about your victory over robbers

t:
This is true, Firebird is there, on our island. Old bach Nikodim owns it. Prays to old tree trunks and roots, lives in the woods, and won’t let anyone even look at the bird.

I owe you my life, so I’ll help you. Take this magic horse! It’s like no other horse in the world! Nikodim once offered me to exchange it for Firebird, but I refused then. Now I am giving it to you!
These thiefs appeared right out of the blue!
No wisdom will help us if we don’t contain the rift… The threat is growing every hour, there are cracks in the crust...

I was not the only one soaring in the skies of Isa a millennium ago! Tooraah's brothers, the ravens Muninn and Huginn often raced with me against the wind. The First appeared when the first words that gave birth to life were spoken over Isa.  It was here that the chains of the one who created us all were broken. And the dragon blood that flowed through Isa became the key to the power of this land.

We have led the Pridens for a long time, but maybe it's time for them to move forward on their own?

Wohoa! Why walking around here, friend? No strangers can walk here! It is dangerous for you! I can help you get upstairs, to the docks. Two silver coins, and my magic carpet will lift you in a wink of an eye, fast and safe, like in mother's arms. Do you agree?
Hold on tight, it's going to be real fast!
h: Pay 2 silver coins to return to the docks.

t: You're poor as a mouse! Go away! No money - no ride!

r495906.s: Prioress of the Church of Light

t:
May the Light bless you!

I'm happy to see you here. Let me wish you a happy anniversary on behalf of all elves – and please accept this invitation to our next Great Ball.

You know, there's something beautiful about these festivities. It's a good occasion for a chat. I already talked to... Elizaveta Rysina. We discussed matters of Faith. And belief in Faith, of course. The thing is, in light of the recent Revelations, we'll have to make amendments to our doctrines.

I also spoke with the Pridens, Aviaks, and Tekyan. Everyone who believes in the Light. I hope soon we'll have a unified Holy Church in Sarnaut!

I'm glad to see you again, - this time on board the Eclipse. The Great Ball is over, and now it's time for the consequences...

I would like to believe Antoinette's politics will lead us into a new era of peace! Perhaps it will be so. For now, we still need to deal with Darkness, so this is no time for disputes.

And, of course, we are faced with eternal questions that our faith in the Light asks us... I think everything is ready for us to overcome our contradictions and try to find the truth. Where do we look for it? I believe you'll find the answer... Who knows where your path takes you? Perhaps Sarnaut is becoming too small for you, !

Think about it after the Anniversary. Relax and have fun for now.

Ah, , I'm glad to see you…

Another year has passed and here we are again on this ship. I wonder what will happen next year?

During this time, we have taken many steps towards our unity. We need to rethink everything we know. Discussions at our cathedral are in full swing, because everyone sees it differently.

So the Church of Eternal Light – which unites the Church of Light, the Trinity Church, and the enlightened Pridens – needs some help.

We believe the answers to our questions are hidden in those other worlds. I believe the Expedition won't be able to proceed without you, so I'd like to ask a favor of you. We need to understand where the Light as a force came from. Does it have a source... besides our faith?

Light gives me strength! We stood firm in the confrontation with the dark goddess and defended the great Cathedral with Hiero and his followers. Now we are facing a much more powerful enemy, Tep. Another face of Darkness, like demons or architects... I know they call themselves differently, but the Light reveals the truth to me - these are all faces of darkness, countless and invincible!

And that Aisa who took people's destinies - isn't she another dark entity?

Face the truth: there is one true path, the path of the primordial light, everything else is false...

Light gives me strength! Do you really think your defection will be forgotten? You swore allegiance to the Dark Goddess, and it doesn't matter that she was deceived by another enemy, another face of Darkness, like demons or architects...

I know they call themselves differently, but the Light reveals the truth to me - these are all faces of darkness, countless and invincible!

And that Aisa who took people's destinies - isn't she another dark entity?

Face the truth: there is one true path, the path of the primordial light, everything else is false...

May the Light bless you!

I'm happy to see you here. Let me wish you a happy anniversary on behalf of all the Elves!

Well... It was an awkward situation. I don't really want to talk about it, but I guess I have to. It is a valuable scientific experience, isn't it?

It is simpler than it might seem. The clone is Elena. Technically. The clone knew... knew everything that she knew, remembered everything that she remembered. She spoke like she did. She thought like she did... Loved like she did.

The only thing that was weird was her obsession with the Object's world. She kept promising to show it to me. That's the funny thing - she wasn't willing to go there herself, she just wanted me to see it. Because... Well, because she knew what I was seeking in my life. She believed she could give it to me. As Elena does.

As for the rest... I suppose the clone was missing the Spark. It is the strangest thing. A living being cannot live without a Spark, as we all know. But she did. And we are yet to find how that was possible.
So, here we are, in the basement of another Imperial laboratory, where another cataclysm is about to break out. We got what we were looking for!

Oh, Light, I wish I could go with you, but I can't... Me and Elizaveta are drained. All we can do is share the grains of force that we still have left with you. I hope it will help you reach Locus and turn it to dust!
May the Light be with you, child. Go and remember - the future of our world is in your hands!

t: Go, and don’t come back! Mart will show you out!
Okay, okay. I'll tell you everything!
You are the flame now! Go without fear, Burning Claw!

Strong body, strong soul! Fire burning in the sacred ring is not just another fire! It burns not only your body, but your very soul. You must become fire to survive. Outlander drink a special potion to become fire!
This place is saturated with ancient magic. Be careful, friend.
How can I live like this? How will I feed and raise children...?
Well? What is it? Are you here to help the pilgrims?
Greetings from the House de Blizare!

It's an interesting place, !

But there's something missing. It's probably the fireworks... I believe I can improve the formula! It's all about brisance. They could stand to be more... striking.

I should discuss this with Catherina. Although it's time for me to return to Gelida. Things are not going well without me... I need to keep an eye on everything, you see.

Alright, let's just try to enjoy ourselves for the time being! Work can wait. That goes for you, too.
My dear friend, we're willing to sign your papers... after you serve the cause of my House.

Our dragons are the descendants of a female dragon named Sturegga. She was captured by the first Conclave of Great Mages. They took her blood to brew their potion of might and immortality. That Conclave consisted of seven Great Mages: Pascal, Elleken, Oberon, Canaan, Maeve, Nemeina, and Melusine. It was destined to fall apart: Canaan turned into a vampire, while Elleken and Nemeina left the others in pursuit of their own goals. I learned this at Zayan's history lessons. He taught me when I was a boy. Do you understand what the former members of the Conclave were after?
We are impressed by what we’ve seen. All that will serve Our people.

Yes, but Armando ruined those plans.

The third Galleon Castle was constructed in secret on Lumenara allod, and our House took no part in it.

One of the first Castles became the Darkblood Citadel, but these days it’s more of a monument to our mistakes and miscalculations. And it will stay on Tenebra as a reminder.
h: As far as I know, the House de Desirae took part in the construction of one of the first Galleon Castles, and it would have been granted to them if the House de Ardeur had won.

t: Hero of Sarnaut! We're glad to see you sober up.
Which Great House is worthy of leading the elven race?

So the votes are collected, the opinions of the Houses are heard. The time has come for the last voice, which is by no means the least important in Our court. We mean your voice, . Over the past days, you have done a lot on Irene, everyone here knows you even if you don't know everyone as well as you should...

Well, it's time for you to make a decision, too.
h: Now I know the opinion of all our leaders

t: After thirty years, We will be glad to shift this heavy burden onto Antoinette's fragile shoulders. Let's see how she handles it.

It would be weird to expect you to make a different choice.

House de Desirae, one of the most ancient Houses, was related to the last royal House of Irene, which enabled Margo de Desirae, the mother of the king, to declare herself the queen. That was when the other Houses arrogantly decided to elect the ruling House at the Great Ball. House de Desirae won several times. We connect our current success with Prince Dakkar, my son. He rekindled the popularity of necromancy among elves, and Conclave lifted the ban! Some unpleasant events took place after that Ball. House de Doucer violated the rules of the Great Game. I couldn't let them go unpunished. You know about the consequences.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are grim bats. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Leia de Desirae will join you. She's an unusual necromancer, my son's follower.

As a king, I can control the supply of Fate Elixirs. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.
h: I want to know more about House de Desirae patronage

t:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are grim bats. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Leia de Desirae will join you. She's an unusual necromancer, my son's follower.

As a king, I can control the supply of Fate Elixirs. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.
h: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Desirae?

t: I'm very busy. What is the matter?

That's what I would love to know, too.

I've received only two reports since they left. The last came in three weeks ago. There's no communication. They should have returned two weeks ago.

A little patience, Child of Sarn.

Soon I will grant you my charms. Very soon!

These auras are powerful spells that casters like myself can put on you. They can help you and your allies in the heat of battle.

However, spells require considerable preparation, so we offer this gift only to those who have proven themselves to be a worthy defender of Eden and the Great Tree.

Unlocking new achievements brings you closer to the reward, but before you can get a stronger aura, you need to unlock the previous one.

Ha-ha! Greetings to you! I am Semer Sanera, and I have something truly special here - a Zombie Kitty! He has returned from the dead and gained unique abilities. Take him with you and give him a chance to become your trusty companion!
These people... You call them people? Rabble and riffraff... I'm a working man... I'm ashamed to look at them... I've worked since childhood...

Well, I need to find something to sell. I'm accustomed to work, and I've heard from a friend that he's opening his own business. Well, I can handle transportation of goods.

r530834.s: Former Guard of the Copper Mountain

t: Ahh! Well? Are you happy now? Mistress kicked me out, and I had to crawl through the swamps like a snake until I was resurrected! We told you - greed never ends well! The malachite is gone. Gone!

Do you know that when this world was shattered, all the ancient primordial forces began to gradually fade away? The broken world could not give us any more energy, and there were much fewer believers... Gradually, one by one, we fell asleep...

Those whom you call deities have many names. Some of them are known as the First, for they were indeed the first to come at the dawn of existence. Some came later, partly created by faith and the power that remained after the creation was completed.

But now everything is different - the Gates to other worlds have opened a door, letting in a stream of power that awakens those who went into hibernation. The Darkness that resurrects the dead also contributes to this. The gods will return soon...

Snakes have always lived on the border of water and earth, belonging to two elements. But beware of Frost who is eager to turn the waters into solid ice. He is the enemy of all living things and the enemy of snakes.
I recently read some kind of appeal... Pyotr Verkhovensky calls for a rebellion against the authorities and suggests starting with arson...
h: Have you heard anything about the arson?

t: Allow me to introduce myself: Mikhail Rubtsov, a student of this university... How do you do?
I read something recently... Some Pyotr Verkhovensky is inciting people to rebel against the government.
h: Have you heard anything about the conspiracy?

t: How strangely business comes to me, an inexperienced widow! Perhaps I had better wait a little longer, seeing that other buyers might come along, and I might be able to compare prices.
There is no accounting for tastes. One man loves the priest, and another the priest's wife. Why are you here? On business or looking to get your ass kicked?
You're with them, then? Perverts and deviants!

She hasn't. Yet! Lada's husband spends a lot of time in the tavern these days. We all know why! They are sitting there all pretty and making eyes at everyone. We know they are buddies with bloodsuckers!

We can let her go, but you'll have to deal with her sooner or later.
h: Girls, leave her alone. She hasn't done anything to you!

t: Keep away or I'll give it to you as well!
I appreciate your help so much! May Tensess bless you! This will teach him to keep his hands to himself!

What groom? Mira Hooves? I’ve only got one beloved, the Light.

All right, I’ll talk to him myself. Let’s run away, before we wake up all the spirits on the island!
h: Your groom asked me to help you.

t: You are not alone! Thank Tensess, you’ve brought in support!

As I returned to Posad, we gathered a great meeting of all our citizens, and here's what we decided: dismiss Mira Hooves from his leader's position, and appoint me instead. We didn't sentence him to death, though, just let him go, and then it turned out that we shouldn't have: less than a week later he returned with a whole gang of bandits and began to rob and kill our civilians! There's more to it. He's even gone as far as setting peace with Newsor Rotheart, the damned demonologist! Murderers and foes are all around the town! Save us, get us rid of this misery...

Are you kidding? Half the guards ran off just at the sight of danger... We sent a messenger to the Queen, but she refused to even talk to him... Mercenaries' price is a way too high. There's a strange knight, who's been drinking at a local bar for a few days now. He's been promising to help, but taken no actions yet. See, you're our last hope... You and Tensess himself...
h: Isn't there anyone else you can lay your hopes on?..
